2608.27847.title: From Uncertainty to Clinical Risk: Severity-Aware Conformal Planning for Interactive Medical Diagnosis
2608.27847.paper_summary: Interactive medical diagnosis dynamically acquires patient information through multiple rounds of questioning, supporting accurate, efficient, and safe clinical decisions under incomplete evidence. Existing methods commonly guide information acquisition with predictive uncertainty or label ambiguity, but overlook the asymmetric clinical risk of missing severe diseases and lack unified long-horizon planning over whether to continue asking questions or commit to a diagnosis. To address these limitations, we propose Severity-Aware Conformal Clinical Planning, which formulates interactive diagnosis as a risk-sensitive sequential decision problem. The framework maintains complementary diagnostic, safety, and masked-evidence beliefs; calibrates turn-specific diagnostic prediction sets and severity-weighted differential-diagnosis risk on held-out diagnostic trajectories; and introduces the calibrated clinical risk into Monte Carlo Tree Search to jointly evaluate long-horizon Ask and Commit trajectories. Experiments on DDXPlus and MediQ show that our method achieves more accurate diagnoses with fewer questions across multiple large language models, while improving differential-diagnosis quality and reducing high-risk errors in severe cases. These findings validate the value of using clinical risk, rather than predictive uncertainty alone, as a planning signal and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework for information acquisition and risk-aware diagnostic decision making. They also motivate future work on clinical-risk-oriented interactive diagnosis and information-acquisition methods.
2608.27847.paper_summary_zh: 互動醫療診斷透過多輪提問動態獲取患者信息，支持在不完整證據下做出準確、高效和安全的臨床決策。現有方法通常以預測不確定性或標籤模糊性指導信息獲取，但忽視了漏診重病的非對稱臨床風險，並缺乏統一的長期規劃，以決定是否繼續提問或確診。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了重症意識的合規臨床規劃，將互動診斷公式化為一個風險敏感的序列決策問題。該框架維持互補的診斷、安全和隱藏證據信念；在保留的診斷軌跡上校準特定回合的診斷預測集和重症加權的差異診斷風險；並將校準的臨床風險引入蒙特卡羅樹搜索，以共同評估長期的詢問和確診軌跡。在DDXPlus和MediQ上的實驗顯示，我們的方法在多個大型語言模型中以更少的提問實現了更準確的診斷，同時提高了差異診斷質量並減少了重症病例中的高風險錯誤。這些發現驗證了使用臨床風險而非僅僅依賴預測不確定性作為規劃信號的價值，並展示了所提出框架在信息獲取和風險意識診斷決策中的有效性。它們還激勵了未來在臨床風險導向的互動診斷和信息獲取方法上的研究。
